notes_txt:
PostCallMD solver export for AI Walkthrough Sample, month 2026-06, scope call.
blocking:
BLOCKING: next_day_off OR Call: The day after an OR Call shift is off, and the stock solver does not keep that rule.
BLOCKING: next_day_off OB Call: The day after an OB Call shift is off, and the stock solver does not keep that rule.
BLOCKING: weekend_block OB Call: One person works Saturday and Sunday of OB Call, and the stock solver does not keep that rule.
BLOCKING: post_call_ok OR Call: Nobody works OR Call the day after call, and the stock solver does not keep that rule.
BLOCKING: post_call_ok OB Call: Nobody works OB Call the day after call, and the stock solver does not keep that rule.
Scope: call. Daily shift types are left out of every file. Daily shifts stay in Daily Staffing in the app.
shift_types.csv lists each shift type in the files with its rules: post_call_ok, next_day_off, weekend_block and color. The open-source solver does not read this file. Read it before you adapt the solver.
clinician_id is the PostCallMD clinician UUID. name is the display name.
Request mapping: vacation -> vacation, hard=1. must_off -> no_call, hard=1. prefer_off -> prefer_off, hard=0. Only approved requests dated in the month are included.
Requests left out because no file can express them: 1 prefer_on (A. Fox, 2026-06-20).
Rules no file can express: next_day_off shift types (the day after is off): OR Call, OB Call. weekend_block shift types (weekend works as one block): OB Call. post_call_ok=0 shift types: OR Call, OB Call.
